title: NoSQLServer v0.92-dev1 native SQLite rowid B-tree seek
summary: NoSQLServer v0.92-dev1 is a full versioned source package in GitHub. It implements signed INTEGER PRIMARY KEY rowid equality seeks by descending the SQLite table B-tree in ooRexx and evaluates the existing NoSQLServer SQLComparisonPredicate on the returned row; SQLite row counts are now lazy rather than scanned at schema discovery.
invariants: No application SQL delegated to SQLite execution by this seek
Only INTEGER PRIMARY KEY rowid-alias equality; other predicates continue via NoSQLServer scan
Signed 64-bit rowids, BLOB, nil and rowid absence preserved
v0.91 writable backend still requires a full backup snapshot per SQL statement
Mark Hessling Rexx/SQL is independently selectable but not a silent NoSQLServer evaluator replacement

qualification.runtime: ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 debug, Alchemy Objects v0.8, Crypto v0.8.3
qualification.result: LOCAL PASS: v0.89-v0.91 regressions and new 10,002-row 512-byte page fixture; negative 64-bit keys, missing ids, BLOB, range scan fallback, guarded UPDATE, integrity_check

performance.recordedComparison: Rexx/SQL indexed ~80us/lookup at 20,000 rows; historical NoSQLServer v0.79 1.2s/lookup at 1,000 rows (different environments/loads)
performance.limits: Full backup per statement still dominates large writable database queries; secondary index / native streaming unimplemented

production.infrastructure: No website, mail, LDAP, HTTPS or MI/MU deployment by this change
